company.name: Jellysmack
company.shortDescription: Jellysmack builds and powers social videos channels through technology.
company.description:
JELLYSMACK is a global creator company that helps creators Go Bigger at every stage of their journey by leveraging technology and data. Its powerful artificial intelligence detects the most promising creators and helps them skyrocket their social growth through multi-platform distribution, financial backing, and data-driven content creation. Jellysmack's all-encompassing infrastructure provides solutions for the world's best creators to save time, take risks, and maximize their value.

Swann Maizil, Robin Sabban, and Michael Philippe founded Jellysmack in 2016.
